comments.body:
Thank you for the contribution and for adding regression tests across the supported locales. The issues you identified with pandas column names and localized status/source values are valid, and the fix addresses those parsing problems.

However, the bulk user import entry point is currently disabled in the frontend, and we do not plan to develop or enable this feature in the near term. We are therefore closing this PR without merging, since the change would maintain a dormant workflow rather than improve a currently supported user-facing feature. This is a product scope decision, rather than a rejection of the reported bug or your approach.

If we revisit bulk user import, we can use this work as a reference and validate the complete import workflow at that time. Thanks again for taking the time to investigate and contribute!
